content.description: Playzap is a community-driven play-to-earn gaming platform. It focuses on casual games where players compete in skill-based tournaments, earn crypto rewards, and participate in a broader PZP token community around accessible competitive play. PlayZap is a play-to-earn community-driven gaming platform where players can compete in skill-based tournaments on proven and highly engaging casual games to win crypto rewards. Important product areas are token holders, community, active wallet players, and fun first gaming.
